title: The next letter
description:
A `char` is really a small number (its ASCII code). Read one character and print the character that comes after it, followed by that character's code:

| Input | Output |
|---|---|
| a | b 98 |
| Y | Z 90 |
| 4 | 5 53 |
hints: `c + 1` is an `int`. To get a character back, convert it: `static_cast<char>(c + 1)`.
To print a character's code instead of the character, convert the other way: `static_cast<int>(next)`.
